privileged_info_summary: The circuit_diagram_lesson task requires an agent to create a 3-page ActivInspire flipchart lesson on electrical circuits saved to /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/circuit_diagram_lesson.flipchart. Page 1 should introduce circuits with 'series' and 'parallel' terminology. Page 2 should show a series circuit diagram with shapes for Battery, Bulb/Resistor, and Switch (minimum 5 shapes for proper representation). Page 3 should show a parallel circuit with at least two branches containing the same components (minimum 6 shapes). ActivInspire is Promethean's proprietary educational software used for creating interactive presentations. Flipchart files are ZIP archives containing XML. The task is synthetic - the agent creates the lesson content during execution. Note: The required_terms metadata is incomplete/misleading - it lists both 'Bulb' and 'Resistor' but the task only requires one or the other, and it omits 'Circuit' which is verified in the verifier logic.
